root_cause.text: Missing deallocation of the path buffer allocated by __getname() on error paths in ceph_mdsc_build_path(), causing memory leaks when the function returns early with an error.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds __putname(path) calls in three error code paths (after encryption failure, after encoded name length error, and when the path exceeds PATH_MAX) to free the previously allocated buffer before returning ERR_PTR. The commit message explicitly states that error paths did not free the "path" pointer obtained by __getname().

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a memory leak in ceph_mdsc_build_path by releasing the path buffer in the error path.
intent_record.what: Added a call to __putname(path) in the error handling block when ret < 0, before returning ERR_PTR(ret).
intent_record.how: Prevents a memory leak by freeing the path buffer allocated earlier in the function before returning an error pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a memory leak on an error path in ceph_mdsc_build_path by freeing the allocated path buffer before returning an error pointer.
intent_record.what: Added __putname(path) before returning ERR_PTR(len) in the error path of ceph_mdsc_build_path.
intent_record.how: Frees the previously allocated path buffer when len is negative, preventing a memory leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Free the allocated path buffer to prevent a memory leak when the path exceeds the maximum allowed length.
intent_record.what: Added a call to __putname(path) before returning ERR_PTR(-ENAMETOOLONG) when the path length exceeds MAXPATHLEN.
intent_record.how: Fixes a memory leak by freeing the allocated path buffer in the error path where the path is too long.
